audience: video game developers and AI game researchers
userScopeOverride: Include AI-created videogames, AI in games, game-AI course projects, and game-specific agent configurations, skills, and tools when the pinned repository is demonstrably about creating or playing videogames. Keep general gaming references and unrelated agent packs out.

relatedPriorCorpus: AI software popularity round; this request intentionally opens a distinct game-development and videogame audience.

searchUniverse.description: Bounded GitHub Search API union; up to first 200 results per query, sorted by stars descending; not a global ranking; eight additional 2026-10-10 queries were limited to the first 100 results each and used stars:>=5; five additional queries/pages widened coverage and required at least 5 stars

queries.query: game playing reinforcement learning in:name,description stars:>0
procedural game generation AI in:name,description stars:>0

selectionCriterion: Among the captured GitHub search universe, select the 500 highest-star repositories that implement a videogame, game AI, AI-assisted game development, a game-AI course project, or a game-specific agent configuration/skill/tool; validate the pinned README and a game-related file before scanning.

selectionChecks.ratingStatus: scanner evidence only; no blind ratings were authored or inferred
